title.zh: 根据 FRD 生成可交互原型

prompt.en: Based on this @FRD.docx and referring to the UI design of this image @reference image.png, generate a usable interactive prototype for me.
prompt.zh: 根据这份 @FRD.docx，并参考这张图片 @reference image.png 的 UI 设计风格，帮我生成一个可用的交互原型。

reply.en: Generated a fully interactive prototype from the FRD, matching the reference UI's layout and visual style, with real navigation between pages. Click this link to interact with the prototype: https://www.noumi.ai/agent/projectmanager/light-systems/projecthub-prototype/
reply.zh: 已根据 FRD 生成一版可交互原型，页面布局和视觉风格参考了给定的设计图，页面之间可以真实跳转。点击下方链接查看完整原型。

caption.en: ProjectHub prototype — project detail & Gantt chart
caption.zh: ProjectHub 原型——项目详情与甘特图
